results.title: UEFA launches disciplinary probe into alleged spitting incident at Nations League match
results.description: UEFA has opened an investigation after an Israeli player was accused of spitting on Ireland staff member Damien Doyle during the half‑time tunnel walk in Serbia.

results.title: Prabowo Briefs 800 Top Military, Police Officers at Palace
results.description: President Prabowo Subianto is set to deliver directives to top Indonesian Military (TNI) and National Police (Polri) officers.
